items.title: Naby Canvas - world-model notes on a live infinite board
items.description: A 'Naby Canvas - infinite board' (You/Aarav LIVE) with linked notes ('How world models work', 'Token memory', 'Action loops', 'Practice'), a yellow sticky 'Don't confuse the world model with the tokenizer', an Aarav cursor tag and a 'What do you want to understand?' input. The same canvas product as VID-0083.

items.title: Category chips - eight colour-coded labelled pills
items.description: Eight entity chips on white: Date & time (green), Job title (grey), Meeting (cyan), Your address (grey), Alarm (pink), Personnel (grey), Role (tan), Priority (orange) - each with a matching icon. A labelled chip set.

items.title: Two list panels - SALES checked, STORAGE UNITS idle
items.description: Two selection panels: SALES (Customer, Sales Orders/Invoices/Packages ticked and highlighted cyan, Shipments) with a checked header box, and STORAGE UNITS (Warehouse, Retail Outlets) unchecked. A paired list-selection state study.

items.title: Ace Studio prompt menu - Plan, Debug, Multitask, Ask
items.description: An 'Ace Studio' ask bar ('What we should work on', 'Ask alpaca anything...', GPT-6 Astra Ultra) with an open skills menu: Plan (Turn plan mode on), Debug (Pinpoint the root cause), Multitask (Orchestrate multiple subagents), Ask (Answer without edits), Files, MCP. A prompt-menu component.

items.title: Ace Studio project menu - repos, use existing, new folder
items.description: The same Ace Studio ask bar with the Project menu open: Repos (On this Mac, Remote, From scratch), Use existing and New folder. A project-source picker component.

items.title: Treatment ladder - Shapes, Blur, Texture, Design to Volta
items.description: Four phones under hand-drawn arrows: 'Shapes' (flat pink/lavender/purple arcs), 'Blur', 'Texture' (dithered), 'Design' - the finished 'Welcome To Volta' splash with logo and Continue with Apple. A visual-treatment process ladder.

items.title: Black blob logo mark with two eye slits
items.description: A white field with a large black blob whose two white slits read as eyes - a minimal animated logo mark, without ribbons.

items.title: Trip Dates component - Sep 10-17 with quick-range chips
items.description: A 'Trip Dates - 7 nights' component: Check-in Sep 10 / Check-out Sep 17, September 2026 grid with the range highlighted, chips (Weekend, 3 nights, 1 week active, 2 weeks, Clear). A date-range picker component, matching the VID-0297 pattern.

items.title: Email docs nav - Analytics tree under Transactional Email
items.description: A document side-nav: 'Transactional Email', active 'Email Analytics' with children (Metrics, Engagement & clicks, Bounces & Diagnostics) and 'AI Email Templates' below. A docs hierarchy moment.

items.title: Floating toolbar - update banner over seven icon controls
items.description: A floating white toolbar (apps grid, chat, inbox, crop, settings, dark-mode moon, close) topped by a purple 'v 1.0.10 - New version available, please update' banner with a cursor. A toolbar + banner component.
